chunks: From him, from his father, from one who mentioned it, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of God (may God's blessings be upon him and his family) forbade crossing the line of camels.
It was said: 'O Messenger of God, and why?' He said: 'Indeed, there is no caravan line except that between every camel and the next there is a devil.'

key_terms.الْبَعِيرُ: A camel (male or female); the primary mode of transport in Arabia
key_terms.الْقِطَارُ: The line or string of camels tied together in a caravan; a convoy of pack animals
key_terms.شَيْطَانٌ: A devil, demon, or malevolent spirit; here stationed between camels
key_terms.يُتَخَطَّى: To step over, cross, or pass between (the line); the prohibited action

ai.seo_question: Why did the Prophet Muhammad forbid crossing a line of camels?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) reports that the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) prohibited walking across or between the line of a camel caravan, explaining that between every two camels in a line stands a devil. This ruling reflects early Islamic concern for spiritual protection and safety during travel, as caravans were central to Arabian life in the 7th century. The audience would have understood 'shaytan' both as literal demonic presence and as a metaphor for the danger of startling animals that could cause harm.

en.hubeali: From him, from his father, from the one who mentioned it,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> forbade cross the line (of the camels).
So it was said, ‘O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>! And why?’ He<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘There is none from the line except and what is between the camel to the camel is a Satan<sup>la</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 6. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from his father from those whom he has mentioned who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, prohibited to cross and intersect the row of camels.
Someone asked, ‘Why is this, O Messenger of Allah?’ He (the Messenger of Allah) said, ‘In every row of camels between every two camels there is a Satan.’”
